name: Erosion of Faith
source:
A holy mission ends in tragedy as Linet finds herself in the cruel north, devoid of the faith she grew up in. Her only lifeline, a strange mercenary, hides more than she lets on.

[From [url=https://electrinut.itch.io/erosion-of-faith]itch.io[/url]]
